def count_sols_via_solver(R3, R3p, target, ab_cap=100000):
    D = R3 ^ R3p
    if D == 0: return None
    d0=D&0xFF; d1=(D>>8)&0xFF; d2=(D>>16)&0xFF; d3=(D>>24)&0xFF
    A=d3^d2; B=d1^d0
    t0=target&0xFF; t1=(target>>8)&0xFF; t2=(target>>16)&0xFF; t3=(target>>24)&0xFF
    def rotl2(v): return ((v<<2)|(v>>6))&0xFF
    ab=[]

        for b in range(256):
            y2=rotl2((a+b+1)&0xFF); y2p=rotl2(((a^A)+(b^B)+1)&0xFF)
            if (y2^y2p)!=t2: continue
            y1=rotl2((b+y2)&0xFF); y1p=rotl2(((b^B)+y2p)&0xFF)
            if (y1^y1p)!=t1: continue
            ab.append((a,b,y2,y2p,y1,y1p))
    n=0

    return len(ab), n
